model: ISYteq controller for eCO Top / eCO Side compact AHUs
applies_to: FläktGroup eCO Top and eCO Side compact air handling units with the built-in ISYteq controller (eCO SEC application).
summary: The ISYteq controller in eCO Top / eCO Side units has BACnet built in, on RS-485 (MS/TP) or Ethernet (BACnet IP). The object list covers external setpoints from the BMS, temperature, humidity, air quality, pressure and flow sensors, coil, fan and damper outputs, setpoints and offsets, sensor and equipment fault flags, collective alarms, unit and control mode multistates and schedules. Most points are read-only; setpoints, enables and mode selections are R/W.
notes: The 210 Trend Log objects in the guide's TRENDLOG table are not listed as points.
Instance numbers repeat across object types (e.g. AI 106011 sensor, AV 106011 control value, BV 106011 sensor fault); always use type plus instance.
The AI table includes R/W external setpoint objects (e.g. AI 3030042) as printed.
Objects can be added or removed as the software evolves; the exact list for a unit is in BMS_List.xlsm and the EDE file in the servdoc folder on the controller SD card.
Descriptions give the printed value range; units as printed (ΔK = temperature difference).

source.title: BACnet ISYteq for eCO Top and eCO Side - datasheet (BACnet register, ISYteq)

integration.summary: Set Protocol to MS/TP on the RS-485 channel (or use Ethernet port 1 for BACnet IP), set name and device instance in the HMI, then command the unit with MV 3939011 Unit Operation Mode and the temperature setpoint, and read temperatures, fan outputs and the collective alarms.

minimum_points.name: Unit Operation Mode
minimum_points.why: Unit mode command: 1 Automatic, 3 Low, 4 High speed...

minimum_points.name: Temperature Control External Setpoint
minimum_points.why: External temperature setpoint from the BMS, °C

integration.enable: MV 3939011 Unit Operation Mode (R/W) selects Automatic, Room Frost Protection, Low/High Speed, Free Profile 1/2 or Night Purge. BV 3030081 / 3131081 / 3232081 let temperature, humidity or air quality control enable the unit.
integration.remote_sensors: The AI external setpoint objects (temperature 3030042, relative 3030043, humidity 3131042, air quality 3232042, fan flow/pressure/manual 133022-24 and 233022-24, outdoor air amount 2929011) are R/W inputs the BMS can write.
setup: MS/TP: HMI /Configuration/Network/RS485, choose channel 1 (A1/B1) or 2 (A2/B2), set Protocol = MS/TP, MAC, baud, BC net, MaxMaster, MaxInfoFrames.
Name and device instance: HMI /Configuration/Network/BACnet/General; EDE export button on the same page. Admin login needed.
gotchas: The same instance number is used by several object types; map by type and instance.
Check BMS_List.xlsm on the controller SD card for the object list of the installed software version.
